    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    m = int(input[1])
    forbidden_products = set(map(int, input[2:])) if n > 0 else set()
    sequence = []
    prefix_product = 1
    used = set(forbidden_products)
    for i in range(m):
        if i not in used:
            new_product = (prefix_product * i) % m
            if new_product not in used:
                sequence.append(i)
                prefix_product = new_product
                used.add(new_product)
    print(len(sequence))
    print(' '.join(map(str, sequence)))
